# 03 Style a flowchart node

## Outcome

`style A fill:#fdd,stroke:#c00` in a flowchart document reaches node A's frame as an inline `style`
attribute, and `render()` reports the same diagnostics for a bad value that a class diagram does.

## Why this ticket exists

The tracer bullet. Every stage — parser, model, layout, renderer — needs one carry-through change
before any of it is observable, so this is one vertical slice rather than four horizontal ones.

`style` first, alone, because it is the directive with no indirection: one statement, one target,
one property list. `classDef`/`class` add a definition table and `linkStyle` adds index resolution,
and neither is worth debugging at the same time as the pipeline itself.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `parseFlowchart` accepts `style <nodeId> <prop>:<value>,...` and records it as a `StyleDecl`.
      `FlowchartDocument` gains a `styles` field.
- [x] A `style` line naming a node that does not exist is an error diagnostic naming the id, at the
      seam ticket 01 established — not a second implementation of the same check.
- [x] `buildFlowchartModel` resolves the document's styles through the shared `resolveStyles`
      against its node ids. It does not declare its own resolver or its own gate.
- [x] `GraphNode`/`PositionedNode` carry the resolved properties through layout unchanged. Assert
      carry-through only; the rules belong to ticket 01's seam.
- [x] `renderToSVG` emits the declarations as an inline `style` attribute on the node's
      `siren-node-frame` rect, in declaration order, and emits no attribute at all when the author
      styled nothing.
- [x] The gate applies identically to flowcharts: `style A fill:url(#evil)` is rejected with the
      same message a class diagram gives, and the other declarations on that line still apply.
      Assert the message, not just that something was rejected.
- [x] A styled node still animates: `style` and a `timeline:` entry on the same node both work, and
      the inline attribute does not disturb the `siren-pending` / `siren-enter-*` class handling.
- [→] **Moved to ticket 03b — out of this ticket's write scope, the planner's error again.**
      `StyleDecl.classIds` keeps its class-diagram name while now holding
      flowchart node ids — `resolveStyles.ts` already reads `for (const targetId of
      declaration.classIds)`, which is the smell in one line. Rename it to `targetIds`. Purely
      mechanical, and this is the ticket where it starts reading wrong.
- [x] **Found by ticket 01b.** `resolveStyles`' diagnostic says `"${authoredAs}" "X" references a
      class that does not exist` — in a module that is otherwise kind-neutral, so a flowchart
      author is told their node is not a class. 01b could not change it (the wording is asserted
      verbatim and changing it was forbidden there); you have the second kind that justifies new
      wording. Change it, and update the assertions that pin it — calling that out in your report
      as the intended change it is.
- [x] Do **not** implement `classDef`, `class`, `:::` or `linkStyle`. Tickets 04 and 05 own those,
      and an unrecognized line must stay an unrecognized line until then.
